title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Help the retail team turn sales and customer activity data into clear insights that support better day-to-day decisions.
responsibilities: Clean and organize weekly sales data in spreadsheets.
Build simple charts and recurring reports for the team.
Explore trends by product or location and summarize useful findings.
requirements: Comfort with spreadsheets and basic formulas.
Curiosity about numbers and attention to detail.
Basic SQL or data visualization experience is helpful, but not required.
learning: Practical reporting, data quality, and how analysts communicate findings to business teams.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Work with a small product team to make online learning pages clear, responsive, and easy for students to use.
responsibilities: Build and refine interface components from product designs.
Check layouts on mobile and desktop screen sizes.
Fix small usability issues and help review changes before release.
requirements: Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Interest in accessible, responsive user interfaces.
Experience with a component framework or Git is a plus.
learning: Component-based development, frontend testing, accessibility, and collaboration in a product team.

title: Content Writer Intern
description: Create helpful digital content that explains ideas simply and keeps a consistent voice across the company's channels.
responsibilities: Draft short articles, social posts, and newsletter copy.
Research topics using reliable public sources.
Edit drafts for clarity, accuracy, tone, and basic search readability.
requirements: Strong written communication and careful proofreading.
Willingness to research unfamiliar subjects.
A writing sample or portfolio is useful but not essential.
learning: Editorial planning, content research, writing for different formats, and constructive editing.

title: Finance Intern
description: Support the finance team with routine analysis and reporting while learning how a fintech business monitors its operations.
responsibilities: Help reconcile and organize expense and invoice records.
Update spreadsheet trackers and prepare routine summaries.
Check figures for missing information and flag discrepancies.
requirements: Currently studying finance, accounting, economics, or a related subject.
Comfort with spreadsheets and accurate record keeping.
Discretion when working with business information.
learning: Financial reporting basics, reconciliation workflows, and practical spreadsheet analysis.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Help design straightforward digital experiences for people using health and wellness products.
responsibilities: Create and refine wireframes and interface mockups.
Organize feedback from quick usability sessions.
Work with product and engineering teammates to improve design handoffs.
requirements: Interest in user-centered design and clear visual communication.
Comfort creating basic wireframes in a design tool.
Curiosity about accessibility and inclusive experiences.
learning: User research, prototyping, design systems, and the path from an idea to a shipped interface.

title: Backend Developer Intern
description: Contribute to the services behind logistics tools, helping keep APIs dependable and operational data easy to work with.
responsibilities: Implement and test small API or service improvements.
Help investigate bugs using logs and reproducible test cases.
Document endpoints and collaborate on code reviews.
requirements: Experience with one programming language and basic data structures.
Understanding of HTTP and JSON APIs.
Familiarity with a database or Git is helpful.
learning: API design, automated testing, service debugging, and collaborative software development.

title: Marketing Intern
description: Help the marketing team plan useful campaigns and tell the story behind a growing food brand.
responsibilities: Prepare social media calendars and draft campaign copy.
Coordinate simple content requests with the design team.
Track engagement metrics and share a short weekly summary.
requirements: Interest in marketing, communications, or consumer brands.
Clear writing and reliable organization.
Basic familiarity with social platforms or spreadsheets is helpful.
learning: Campaign planning, brand communication, content coordination, and reading engagement metrics.

title: Customer Support Intern
description: Help customers get clear answers about mobility services and share recurring feedback with the product team.
responsibilities: Respond to common questions using the team's support guidelines.
Record issue details clearly and route complex cases to the right team.
Notice recurring questions and help improve support articles.
requirements: Patient, clear written communication.
A thoughtful and respectful approach to customer questions.
Comfort learning new tools and following documented processes.
learning: Customer communication, support workflows, issue triage, and how user feedback informs product improvements.
